This pedal can be powered by a 9-volt battery, a Dunlop ECB003 9-volt adapter, or the DC Brick™, Iso-Brick™, and Mini Iso-Brick™ power supplies (not included). Warranty Information The Long Story Ultimate riff power is yours with the Fullbore Metal Distortion pedal from MXR. This compact but powerful device is all you need to unleash the most devastating contemporary metal guitar tones ever heard. The Fullbore Metal Distortion turbo-charges your guitar signal with lethal amounts of ultra high gain. This is combined with a built-in Noise Gate to knock out the noise associated with extreme gain levels while also adding definition and tightness to syncopated metal riffs. You may find the information you need in the FAQs about the MXR FULLBORE METAL DISTORTION M116 listed below. How do I reduce noise when using the MXR FULLBORE METAL? To reduce noise, activate the noise gate by pressing the GATE button. You can adjust the sensitivity of the noise gate using the internal GATE TRIGGER control. Turn it clockwise to increase sensitivity, which will cut off noise faster. 0 How can I get a scooped nu-metal sound from the MXR FULLBORE METAL? Press the SCOOP button to activate a scooped nu-metal sound, which enhances the low and high frequencies. 0 How do I power the MXR FULLBORE METAL? The MXR Fullbore Metal can be powered by a 9-volt battery or a 9-volt AC adapter, like the Dunlop ECB003/ECB003E, or through a DC Brick power supply. 0 What should I do if the notes are being cut off too early with the noise gate on? If notes are being cut off too early, adjust the internal GATE TRIGGER control counter-clockwise to decrease the noise gate's sensitivity. 0 How can I adjust midrange frequencies on the MXR FULLBORE METAL? Use the FREQ knob to select the midrange frequency you want to adjust, then use the MID knob to control the amount of that frequency. 0 Is the manual of the MXR FULLBORE METAL DISTORTION M116 available in English?
